name: example-archive-elastic-gallery
title: Archive Elastic Gallery
description: A perpetually-reshuffling gallery grid choreographed by a self-driven boomerang playhead: differential per-column elastic lag stretches the grid like taffy, a perspective depth-shuffle cycles between two 3D recipes every loop, and one tile auto-fires a sliced-band hover-distortion reveal with a character-scramble caption on a timer — continuous motion from frame 0, no scroll or hover required.
